name: takeover_wlroots
about: The take-over under headless sway. Pending, a known gap: sway tells no client where the pointer is, so the agent's guard can't see a hand on the mouse by the pointer's drift, and HID activity during a batch falls in Jarvis's own injection windows; the task pauses only for input after the batch. Hyprland says where the pointer is (hyprctl cursorpos), so the drift check works there: confirmed live in task 8 of PLAN-computer-use.md.
say: In the Jarvis Test Notes app, make a new note titled Groceries with milk, eggs and bread in it, and save it.
